entities.name: Crimson Peaks
entities.description: A huge mountain range in southern Sarpadia on Dominaria, once inhabited by dwarves and humans, where dragons laid eggs.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria containing the Crimson Peaks.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The world of the Crimson Peaks.

entities.name: Dwarves of Sarpadia
entities.description: Dwarves who defended the Crimson Peaks but were eradicated by raids; their empire's name is lost.

entities.name: Brave Rabbit Inn
entities.description: Tavern in an unnamed village in the northern Crimson Peaks.

entities.name: Tigaden
entities.description: Village in the far south hosting the Squat Duck inn.

entities.name: Kalitas
entities.description: Dwarven town in the Crimson Peaks.

entities.name: Teedmar
entities.description: Dwarven town near Gurn Keep, wiped out by a volcanic eruption.

entities.name: Shanin
entities.description: Northernmost mountain in the Crimson Peaks, with a dragon's roost.

entities.name: Sekena
entities.description: A dwarf who bonded with the dragon of Shanin before the Fall of the Sarpadian Empires.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: Order that helped destroy the Crimson Peaks dwarves.

entities.name: Ivra Jursdotter
entities.description: Led troops supplied by the Ebon Hand to aid the orcs and goblins.

entities.name: Orcs and goblins of Sarpadia
entities.description: Swept south into the Crimson Peaks and conquered the dwarves, then hid from thrulls.

entities.name: Thrulls
entities.description: Massing creatures from which the orcs and goblins hid.

events.summary: After the dwarven seat in the northern Sarpadian Mountains falls, orcs and goblins sweep south into the Crimson Peaks.
events.quote: the tide of orcs and goblins swept south into the Crimson Peaks

events.summary: The Order of the Ebon Hand sets off a volcanic eruption wiping out Teedmar and supplies troops under Ivra Jursdotter to aid the orcs and goblins.
events.quote: setting off a volcanic eruption that wiped out the city of Teedmar

events.summary: The dwarves of the Crimson Peaks are eradicated by continual raids, leaving a mass grave.
events.quote: The Crimson Peaks dwarves defended their lands valiantly but were eventually eradicated by continual raids.

relations.note: In the southern part of Sarpadia.
relations.quote: a huge mountain range in the southern part of Sarpadia

relations.note: Supplied troops to aid their efforts.
relations.quote: supplying troops led by Ivra Jursdotter that chose to aid the orcs and goblins' efforts
The Crimson Peaks dwarves defended their lands valiantly

relations.note: Bonded with the dragon roosting on Shanin.
relations.quote: which bonded with the dwarf Sekena just before the Fall of the Sarpadian Empires
